patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Linear and Notion share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Linear only if your buying job matches “Modern issue tracker for product/engineering teams — Free limited; Basic from ~$8/user/mo ” rather than Notion's shape. Choose Notion only if your buying job matches “Docs-first workspace with databases and light project tracking — Plus from $10/user/mo ann” rather than Linear's shape. Workflow advantage: Linear leans project-tracking; Notion leans team-collaboration-work. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Linear and Notion share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Linear is Modern issue tracker for product/engineering teams — Free limited; Basic from ~$8/user/mo annual.; Notion is Docs-first workspace with databases and light project tracking — Plus from $10/user/mo annual; AI on Business..
- Company-size focus: Linear (startup, small-business, mid-market) vs Notion (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Linear-leaning project-tracking vs Notion-leaning team-collaboration-work.
- Researched limits: Linear — Not for company-wide marketing/ops Work OS; Notion — Not a full Work OS for portfolio/resource management.

Limitations — Linear: Not for company-wide marketing/ops Work OS; Leaner automation than Jira Enterprise; Notion: Not a full Work OS for portfolio/resource management; Reporting/dashboards thinner than dedicated PM tools.

Poor-fit cases: Linear is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not for company-wide marketing/ops Work OS · Notion is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a full Work OS for portfolio/resource management · Avoid Linear if you actually need Notion's motion (Docs-first workspace with databases and light project tracking — Plus from $10/u)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
